title: fix: lean empty state on activity usage and earnings cards
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
Cleans up the Usage and Earnings cards on the activity page when a period has no data, and drops the week view.

- Hides the Keys/Apps, Models and Pollen/Requests controls when the period has nothing to filter; only the period nav and a disabled CSV button remain
- Replaces the bare-text empty state with a fixed-height panel matching the chart and loading heights
- Shrinks the period nav and CSV button, reusing the existing `IconButton size="md"` for navigation arrows
- Removes the week granularity from the picker and URL parsing; week URLs fall back to the day view
- Adds `hasPeriodData` to the earnings hook, mirroring usage

No API or data changes.

Validation: formatting passes; all 6 existing Button and IconButton tests pass.

gist.headline: A quieter empty hive
gist.blurb: Quiet periods on the Activity page now get a proper place to rest. Usage and Earnings keep their chart-shaped rooms tidy, rather than leaving stray filters to forage alone.
gist.summary: The Activity page now uses fixed-height empty panels for Usage and Earnings, hides irrelevant Keys/Apps, Models, and Pollen/Requests filters when a period has no data, and consolidates period selection around day-based fallback behavior instead of week URLs.
gist.impact: Users viewing an inactive period get a stable chart-sized empty state, simpler period navigation, a disabled CSV action, and no filters that cannot affect the displayed data.
gist.visual_concept: Depict the Activity dashboard as a cozy garden chart bed during a quiet day: Polli gently tidies away unused filter tags while a neat, chart-shaped blank panel waits beneath a small day-calendar and inactive CSV button. The scene represents a deliberately calm, uncluttered no-data state rather than an error.
